generator.description:
Fixed nonlinear PCRL pilot: protection-aware upstream training before LEACE.

L=(U,V,S,E1,...,E5) ~ N(0,I8); X=(LQ1 + .2*(LQ1)^3)Q2+b.
The two fixed orthogonal matrices and the monotone componentwise cubic make
the observation map invertible. No generator parameter depends on outcomes.

configuration.primary_utility: mean independently fitted MLP task probe R2 for U and V
configuration.feasibility: All five prohibited recipient/target scores satisfy their threshold for BOTH linear and MLP validation attackers
configuration.selection: Among C and two D strengths, highest validation utility if feasible; otherwise minimum sum normalized excess then highest utility, then smaller strength. Also select among positive strengths by the same rule.
